description: Reusable tabletop, playing-card, seat, token, and card-game presentation components for React Native and React Native Web.

readmeUsage.title: Minimal tabletop app root.
readmeUsage.description:
Minimal tabletop app root.

Use `TabletopTable` inside a ZORA app shell to render generic seats, visible
cards, face-down cards, and center-table labels without adding game rules.

exports.name: CardBack
exports.description:
Face-down playing-card primitive for hidden cards and decks.

Use `CardBack` when a card should be represented visually without exposing its
rank or suit. The component keeps a generic accessible label for hidden cards.

exports.name: createPokerTrainingTableState
exports.description:
Adapts the table-relevant subset of a poker training task to generic tabletop presentation state.

The canonical poker ring is rotated so the hero occupies the first (bottom) tabletop seat.
Players omitted by the task are reconstructed as folded with the configured default stack.

signatures.label: (task: PokerTrainingTaskTableData, { defaultStackBigBlinds = 100 }?: CreatePokerTrainingTableStateOptions) => PokerTrainingTableState

parameters.name: task
parameters.description: - Serializable poker training task data received by the generated application.

signatures.returnDescription: Seats and shared-table content ready for `TabletopTable`.

exports.name: createTabletopColorScheme
exports.description:
Creates the theme-derived color palette used by tabletop primitives.

Use `createTabletopColorScheme` when custom components need to align with the
same card, table, seat, token, and contrast-aware foreground colors as the
built-in tabletop components.

exports.name: createTabletopGameSeats
exports.description:
Joins an ordered game layout with the participant states currently present in a scene.

Missing participants retain their seat definition and receive the configured fallback state,
which lets card games represent folded, eliminated, disconnected, or otherwise inactive seats
without embedding those game rules in the tabletop renderer.

examples.title: Generic four-seat game

signatures.returnDescription: Normalized tabletop seats in the same order as the supplied seat definitions.

exports.name: PlayingCard
exports.description:
Theme-aware face-up playing card primitive.

Use `PlayingCard` for visible card values in hands, shared table cards, piles,
or custom tabletop layouts. The component renders rank and suit glyphs and
exposes an accessible card label by default.

signatures.label:
({
  card,
  size = 'medium',
  selected = false,
  muted = false,
  accessibilityLabel,
  colorScheme,
  testID,
}: PlayingCardProps) => React.JSX.Element

parameters.name:
{
  card,
  size = 'medium',
  selected = false,
  muted = false,
  accessibilityLabel,
  colorScheme,
  testID,
}

exports.name: PokerTrainingTable
exports.description:
Manifest-ready poker training pattern that reconstructs a complete table from task data.

Bind the raw training task object to `task`; the pattern maps sparse active-player data to a
full nine-seat presentation while leaving API execution in the generated application.

members.name: blinds
members.type: { readonly small: number; readonly big: number; } | undefined

exports.name: TabletopTable
exports.description:
Responsive tabletop surface for generic card-game and board-game scenes.

Use `TabletopTable` to arrange seats around a themed table surface, display
shared center cards, and show neutral seat labels/tokens without embedding game
rules into the component.

signatures.label:
({
  seats,
  centerCards = [],
  centerLabel,
  centerSublabel,
  shape = 'oval',
  seatCount,
  cardSize = 'small',
  disabled = false,
  colorScheme,
  accessibilityLabel,
  testID,
}: TabletopTableProps) => React.JSX.Element

parameters.name:
{
  seats,
  centerCards = [],
  centerLabel,
  centerSublabel,
  shape = 'oval',
  seatCount,
  cardSize = 'small',
  disabled = false,
  colorScheme,
  accessibilityLabel,
  testID,
}

componentComposition.jsxElement:
<View
      accessibilityLabel={accessibilityLabel ?? createHiddenCardLabel()}
      accessibilityRole="image"
      style={[
        styles.card,
        {
          backgroundColor: colors.cardBack,
          borderColor: colors.cardBackBorder,
          borderRadius: dimensions.radius,
          height: dimensions.height,
          opacity: muted ? 0.48 : 1,
          width: dimensions.width,
        },
      ]}
      testID={testID}
    >

<View
        style={[
          styles.inner,
          {
            borderColor: colors.cardBackBorder,
            borderRadius: Math.max(2, dimensions.radius - 3),
          },
        ]}
      />
<View accessibilityLabel={accessibilityLabel} style={styles.hand} testID={testID}>

<PlayingCard
          card={card}
          colorScheme={colorScheme}
          key={`${card.rank}-${card.suit}-${index}`}
          muted={muted}
          size={size}
          testID={testID ? `${testID}-card-${index}` : undefined}
        />

<CardBack
          colorScheme={colorScheme}
          key={`hidden-${index}`}
          muted={muted}
          size={size}
          testID={testID ? `${testID}-hidden-${index}` : undefined}
        />

<View
      accessibilityLabel={accessibilityLabel ?? getPlayingCardLabel(card)}
      accessibilityRole="image"
      style={[
        styles.card,
        {
          backgroundColor: colors.cardSurface,
          borderColor: selected ? colors.seatSelectedBorder : colors.cardBorder,
          borderRadius: dimensions.radius,
          height: dimensions.height,
          opacity: muted ? 0.48 : 1,
          width: dimensions.width,
        },
      ]}
      testID={testID}
    >

<Text
        selectable={false}
        style={[
          styles.rank,
          {
            color: suitColor,
            fontSize: dimensions.rankFontSize,
            lineHeight: dimensions.rankFontSize + 4,
          },
        ]}
      >

<Text
        selectable={false}
        style={[
          styles.suit,
          {
            color: suitColor,
            fontSize: dimensions.suitFontSize,
            lineHeight: dimensions.suitFontSize + 3,
          },
        ]}
      >

<TabletopTable
      {...tableProps}
      accessibilityLabel={accessibilityLabel ?? state.accessibilityLabel}
      centerCards={state.centerCards}
      centerLabel={state.centerLabel}
      centerSublabel={state.centerSublabel}
      seatCount={9}
      seats={state.seats}
    />

<View
      accessibilityLabel={accessibilityLabel}
      style={[styles.root, { opacity: disabled ? 0.56 : 1 }]}
      testID={testID}
    >

<View
        style={[
          styles.surface,
          shape === 'circle' ? styles.circleSurface : styles.ovalSurface,
          shape === 'rounded' ? styles.roundedSurface : null,
          {
            backgroundColor: colors.tableFelt,
            borderColor: colors.tableBorder,
          },
        ]}
      >

<View
          pointerEvents="none"
          style={[
            styles.innerSurface,
            shape === 'circle' ? styles.circleSurface : styles.ovalSurface,
            shape === 'rounded' ? styles.roundedSurface : null,
            { borderColor: colors.tableInnerBorder },
          ]}
        />
<View style={styles.centerContent}>
<CardHand cards={centerCards} colorScheme={colorScheme} size={cardSize} />
<View style={[styles.centerLabel, { backgroundColor: colors.seatSurface }]}>
<Text style={[styles.centerLabelText, { color: colors.seatText }]}>
<Text style={[styles.centerSublabel, { color: colors.tableMutedText }]}>

<View
            accessibilityLabel={createSeatAccessibilityLabel(seat)}
            accessibilityRole="summary"
            key={seat.id}
            style={[
              styles.seatSlot,
              {
                left: position.left,
                opacity: seat.muted ? 0.48 : 1,
                top: position.top,
              },
            ]}
            testID={testID ? `${testID}-seat-${seat.id}` : undefined}
          >

<View
              style={[
                styles.seatPanel,
                seat.selected ? styles.selectedSeatPanel : null,
                {
                  borderColor: seat.selected ? colors.seatSelectedBorder : colors.seatBorder,
                  backgroundColor: colors.seatSurface,
                },
              ]}
            >

<CardHand
                  cards={seat.cards}
                  colorScheme={colorScheme}
                  faceDownCards={seat.faceDownCards}
                  muted={seat.muted ?? seat.disabled}
                  size={seatCardSize}
                />
<View style={styles.seatTextGroup}>
<Text style={[styles.seatLabel, { color: colors.seatText }]}>
<Text style={[styles.seatSublabel, { color: colors.seatMutedText }]}>

<View
                style={[
                  styles.token,
                  {
                    backgroundColor: colors.tokenSurface,
                    borderColor: seat.selected
                      ? colors.seatSelectedBorder
                      : colors.tableInnerBorder,
                  },
                ]}
              >
<Text style={[styles.tokenText, { color: colors.tokenText }]}>
